name: corhazi-arsonist-hit-unit-that-dies-is-banished-instead
notes: Corhazi Arsonist: a unit it hit this turn is banished instead of dying. Pre-fix the On Hit read an undefined $target and never marked the unit, so it went to the graveyard.

rulesClauses: If a unit hit by CARDNAME this turn would die, banish it instead.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Corhazi Arsonist: the generated On Hit ($target) read a variable that was only defined in the ability body that queued it (PHP closures do not share scope), so it was undefined (null) at resolution. Overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php; the value is recomputed where it is used.
